title: Data source research candidate
description: One entry per candidate evaluated by the research-sources skill. File name is research/candidates/<slug>.json.

slug.description: Matches the filename stem and the memo filename suffix.

granularity.description: e.g. tract, zcta, county, msa, national.

license.description: License/ToS summary; note any commercial-use or login restriction.

cost.description: Only 'free' candidates are proposed; note rate limits in notes.

auth.description: Whether a key/token is needed, even if free.

fits_existing_adapter.description: Path of an existing adapter this could extend instead of a new Source subclass.

replaces_hardcoded_assumption.description: Dotted name of a hardcoded constant this would feed instead, if any.

correlation.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py, if it exists and was run.
